rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the trio consists of people, including three musicians when no technical musical term is needed.

example.english: Those three are always together; they’re really the office trio.
example.traditional: 嗰三個人成日黐埋一齊，真係公司入面嘅三人組。
example.jyutping: go2 saam1 go3 jan4 seng4 jat6 ci1 maai4 jat1 cai4 zan1 hai6 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 ge3 saam1 jan4 zou2

rows.note: Use this grouping construction for three countable things treated as one group or set rather than for a named group of people.

example.english: Pack the goods into boxes, with each trio kept together.
example.traditional: 啲貨要三個一組咁放入盒裏面。
example.jyutping: di1 fo3 jiu3 saam1 go3 jat1 zou2 gam3 fong3 jap6 hap6 leoi5 min6

rows.note: Use this in a specifically musical context for either the three-musician ensemble or a piece written for it.

example.english: This trio has to be performed by piano, violin, and cello.
example.traditional: 呢首三重奏要由鋼琴、小提琴同大提琴一齊演奏。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau2 saam1 cung4 zau3 jiu3 jau4 gong3 kam4 siu2 tai4 kam4 tung4 daai6 tai4 kam4 jat1 cai4 jin2 zau3
